identity.summary: UFC lists the Japanese flyweight, whose bio says he wrestled, finished second as a Junior Olympian and competed at Worlds. UWW's Rei TSURUYA (JPN, aged 24 in 2026) wrestled the 2019 Cadet Worlds, which matches his age and country.

checks.name: United World Wrestling athlete page, TSURUYA Rei

claims.result: 21st; lost his qualification bout to Dimitri Khachidze by technical superiority (0-8)

sources.name: United World Wrestling athlete page, TSURUYA Rei

national.note: Single page read by hand (owner has UWW permission). Participation only, no medal. The 'second as a Junior Olympian' in his bio is a separate claim that hasn't been checked.
